facts.fact_text: The applicant took part in the rally held on 31 March 2012 at Triumfalnaya Square in Moscow.
At 6.30 p.m. on 31 March 2012 the applicant was arrested and brought to the police station.

On 17 April 2012 the Justice of the Peace of Precinct no. 367 of the Tverskoy District of Moscow found the applicant administratively liable for violation of the established procedure for organising a public assembly.
On 17 April 2012 the Justice of the Peace of Precinct no. 367 of the Tverskoy District of Moscow fined the applicant RUB 500.

On 17 April 2012 the Justice of the Peace of Precinct no. 367 of the Tverskoy District of Moscow found that the rally held on 31 March 2012 had been organised in contravention of the existing procedure.

According to the Moscow authorities, the march along the indicated route from Triumfalnaya Square down Tverskaya Street to Manezh Square would disrupt the normal functioning of the city's infrastructure and traffic.

According to the Moscow authorities, the march along the indicated route from Triumfalnaya Square down Tverskaya Street to Manezh Square would infringe the rights and interests of people who would not take part in the rally and the march.
On 20 March 2012 the Government of Moscow refused to agree on the venues for the rally and the march planned for 31 March 2012.
According to the Moscow authorities, there was archaeological and construction work going on in Triumfalnaya Square at the time of the planned rally.

According to the Moscow authorities, the march along the indicated route from Triumfalnaya Square down Tverskaya Street to Manezh Square would disrupt the normal functioning of the city's infrastructure and traffic.

According to the Moscow authorities, the march along the indicated route from Triumfalnaya Square down Tverskaya Street to Manezh Square would infringe the rights and interests of people who would not take part in the rally and the march.
